title: #068. Thermal Power Unit Commitment
subtitle: Schedule generator on/off commitments and hourly dispatch subject to startup costs, ramp limits, and minimum up/down times.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { commitment, generation, totalCost }.
judge.m1: Field "{p0}" must have {p1} rows (one per generator).
judge.m3: generation[{p0}][{p1}] ({p2}) must lie in [{p3}, {p4}] for its commitment status.
judge.m4: Total generation at hour {p0} ({p1}) does not equal demand ({p2}).
judge.m5: Generator {p0} ramp change at hour {p1} ({p2}) exceeds rampLimit ({p3}).
judge.m6: Generator {p0} startup output at hour {p1} ({p2}) exceeds startup limit ({p3}).
judge.m7: Generator {p0} output before shutdown at hour {p1} ({p2}) exceeds shutdown limit ({p3}).
judge.m8: Generator {p0} started at hour {p1} must stay ON for at least {p2} hours (turned off at hour {p3}).
judge.m9: Generator {p0} shut down at hour {p1} must stay OFF for at least {p2} hours (turned on at hour {p3}).
judge.m10: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match recomputed startup + fuel cost ({p1}).
judge.m11: Valid unit commitment schedule, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
